text_block_list.text:
This place is called the paddock.
Runners
appear here before the race to
excite
their adoring fans!
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
Attention! There are various things you

can confirm here at the paddock before

the race!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the detailed explanations to

you, Tazuna!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
